services.h2: The work you repeat every single day can be made easier
services.lead: Some of it never quite counts as a problem — but with the right system behind it, you save hours and stop redoing the same work.

items.title: Bookings arrive by chat, and double-book
items.desc: Enquiries come in across several channels, so you scroll back through messages one by one — and when two people book the same slot, they clash. We build booking that customers complete themselves, around the clock, with one shared queue your whole team sees.

items.title: Past customers drift away unnoticed
items.desc: Most shops have no way to bring earlier customers back. We build membership and loyalty points on LINE — no extra app to install — so promotions land directly in the hands of people who already bought from you.

items.title: Month-end close eats a whole day
items.desc: Figures sit scattered across notebooks, Excel and chat threads, and by the time they add up the decision is already late. We build back-office systems and dashboards that total revenue, costs and your busiest hours automatically.

items.title: The same typing, over and over
items.desc: Copying details out of chat into Excel, then typing the receipt again — hours gone every day. We connect the tools you already use so the data flows through on its own, with nothing re-entered by hand.

items.title: You want a system but not sure where to start
items.desc: The worry is paying for more than you need, or building something nobody ends up using. We help separate what to build first from what can wait, with a budget and an expected outcome before you commit.

items.title: The old system broke and nobody will fix it
items.desc: Plenty of people have paid for a system and then lost contact with whoever built it. We hand over the full source code and every owner account, and stay available to support and extend it as the business grows.

works.h2: Projects you can open and try right now
works.lead: Every system below was designed and built entirely by our team, front end through back end.

items.name: JongGo
items.desc: Booking and loyalty built on LINE — four steps to book, with a choice of staff member or table, a queue ticket delivered as a Flex Message with a check-in QR, points earned and redeemed automatically, plus an in-store queue display and a dashboard covering revenue and the busiest hours of the week.
items.schemaDesc: Booking and loyalty system built on LINE. Four steps to book, queue tickets sent as Flex Messages with check-in QR codes, automatic points earning and redemption, an in-store queue display and a revenue dashboard.

items.name: KidTang
items.desc: Works out your government benefit without any arithmetic, pinpointing the daily spend that earns the largest top-up. Sign in with LINE for advice based on your own situation, and track how much of your allowance you have used each month.
items.schemaDesc: Calculator for the Thai Plus government scheme. Finds the daily spend that earns the largest top-up, signs in with LINE and tracks the allowance used each month.

items.name: Judgement
items.desc: A platform for full Rider–Waite readings across all 78 cards, with interpretations for both upright and reversed draws. Readers pick their own cards, choose between three modes (free question, card of the day, or a set of 71 questions across 11 categories), and receive an AI interpretation based on what they have shared.
items.schemaDesc: Tarot platform covering the full 78-card Rider-Waite deck. Readers pick their own cards across three modes, with 71 questions in 11 categories and AI-written interpretations.

items.name: Pimjai
items.tagline: Leave a message anywhere on the world map
items.desc: A platform for messages tied to coordinates on the world map. Drop a pin, write a message at exactly that spot, and let whoever passes through read it there — an interactive map woven together with a messaging system.
items.schemaDesc: Platform for leaving messages tied to coordinates on a world map. Drop a pin, write a message at that spot, and let others read it by location.

items.name: GenQR
items.desc: A QR code generator covering plain text, links, phone numbers, email, SMS, Wi-Fi credentials, Google Maps coordinates and social profiles (LINE, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), with colours you choose yourself, in both Thai and English.
items.schemaDesc: QR code generator supporting text, links, phone numbers, email, SMS, Wi-Fi credentials, Google Maps coordinates and social profiles, with custom colours, in Thai and English.

process.h2: A process you can check at every step
process.lead: The first consultation costs nothing, and we ask for no deposit until both sides have agreed the scope and the price.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.desc: Describe the problems you run into day to day, however suits you. We write them up as a requirements document you can review.

steps.title: Quote & timeline
steps.desc: Scope, the features included, the delivery date and the payment stages — all in writing.

steps.title: Design & build
steps.desc: Screen designs come to you for approval before development starts, with progress reported as we go.

steps.title: Handover & training
steps.desc: We deploy it for real use, with a manual and training for your team until they are comfortable running it.

steps.title: Ongoing support
steps.desc: Bug fixes are covered for 30 days, and we take on new features as the business grows.

reviews.lead: The things clients mention most: work finished fast, quality that matches what they asked for, prices they could talk through, and explanations detailed enough to actually follow.

paragraphs: I'm so impressed. Seriously talented, and so patient with me. I know nothing about code, so I had to keep asking questions, and every single time the answer came back gently and in detail. Explained so well that it was easy to understand.

So patient with me, even when I asked a lot or didn't get something — always calm, always a good answer. And the work was fast, and really cared about. Beautiful, detailed work, worth the price or more. This job was rushed too: ordered today, wanted today. Still delivered better than expected, and hours ahead of the deadline — due at 3am, finished by 11pm. Really accommodating. The loveliest.

I'd seen people on X saying the pricing was expensive or whatever. I don't think it's expensive at all — better value than plenty of others, and the work is excellent. The highest quote I got elsewhere was 5,000, and the care here isn't even comparable. Talking it through felt reassuring, like I knew it would be on time and exactly as requested.

Anyway, cheering you on. Keep going, you're brilliant. And if anyone else is reading this review, you can be confident: no scams, nobody disappearing, fast work, excellent work, better than you expect. The work you did for me scored 94% from my lecturer. Thank you so much 🙏 I'll definitely be back.

faq.h2: What people ask before we start

items.q: How much does it cost to start?
items.a: Price depends on the scope and how many features are involved — a single-page business site starts far lower than a system with a back office and membership. Send over the details first and we will assess it and give you a written quote at no cost, with no deposit asked for at this stage.
items.schemaA: Price depends on the scope and how many features are involved. A single-page business site starts far lower than a system with a back office and membership. Send over the details and IT Student Service will assess it and provide a written quote at no cost, with no deposit required at this stage.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A small website takes roughly 1–2 weeks; a system with a back office, membership, or a LINE integration takes roughly 3–8 weeks. The delivery date is stated in the quote from the outset, and progress is reported every week.
items.schemaA: A small website takes roughly 1-2 weeks. A system with a back office, membership or LINE integration takes roughly 3-8 weeks. The delivery date is stated in the quote from the outset and progress is reported weekly.

items.q: How many rounds of revisions do I get?
items.a: During development you can revise as agreed in the scope, and after handover bug fixes are covered for 30 days at no extra charge. For new features outside the original scope, we always tell you the price before starting.
items.schemaA: During development revisions are included as agreed in the scope, and after handover bug fixes are covered for 30 days at no extra charge. For new features outside the original scope, the price is always given before work starts.

items.a: The source code belongs to you. Once the agreed payment stages are complete, we hand over the source code, ownership of the hosting and database accounts, and the user manual — so you are never locked to one developer if you decide to move to another team later.
items.schemaA: The source code belongs to the client. Once the agreed payment stages are complete, the client receives the source code, ownership of the hosting and database accounts, and the user manual, so they are never locked to one developer if they move to another team later.

items.q: Do you take on student projects or theses?
items.a: We provide technical consulting, system architecture and help debugging your code, so that you build and present the work yourself. Send over your topic and deadline and we will take a look.
items.schemaA: IT Student Service provides technical consulting, system architecture and help debugging code so that students build and present the work themselves. Send the topic and deadline for an assessment.

about.h2: Who IT Student Service is, and what we do
about.lead: IT Student Service (นักเรียนไอที) is a software development team based in Thailand, building web applications, admin systems and LINE OA products, and advising on software solutions. We work entirely online, which means we take on projects anywhere in the country.

specs.dd: Web applications · LINE-based systems (OA / LIFF / Flex Message) · back office and dashboards · API integration with existing systems · software consulting · post-launch support
More than 100 projects delivered for over 10 clients, with 5 live systems on this page you can open and try.
All of Thailand — 100% online from first call to handover, no province off limits.
Small websites 1–2 weeks · systems with a back office, membership or LINE integration 3–8 weeks
Quotes are scoped and priced at no cost, no deposit is taken before the price is agreed, and anything outside the agreed scope is priced before work begins.
30 days of bug fixes after handover, along with training and a user manual.
Source code and ownership of the hosting and database accounts are handed over in full once payment stages are complete. No lock-in to the developer.
Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · LINE Messaging API · LIFF · REST APIs and webhooks
